simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פַּרְשֵׁז (H6576) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: פַּרְשֵׁז (parshêz) means to expand First listed occurrence: Job 26 9.

definitions.full: H6576. parsez מַּרְשֵׂז (Baer, שֵׁז - van d. H. Gi), Infinitive absolute Pi`lel (Ges § 56 ) from מָּרַשׂ (si vera lectio) ׳פ עֲנָנוֺ עָלָיו Job 26:9 a spreading his cloud upon it (but Bu Du and others read מָּרַשׂ מֹּרֵשׂ, , or פָרשֹׁ ).
definitions.rootNote: a root apparently formed by compounding 6567 and that of 6518 (compare 6574 );
